text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Local Lustre: parallelism and copy recipes
Points = means of 3 runs; whiskers = observed min–max.
Curves: rcp file limits and dcp MPI ranks. Horizontal lines: separate cp/rsync recipes; dashed = scripted 10-process copies.
Larger points identify automatic rcp and the benchmark's 32-rank dcp default. Marker shape identifies the tool, not parallelism.
Single-process cp and rsync were excluded on the 1 kB workload.
Settings on the x-axis are categories; automatic rcp is shown separately. Sizes are decimal; the 1 kB workload has ~100× fewer bytes.
